specification:
Create a stunning, interactive, and responsive website for "SecureFish Technologies" that demonstrates all advanced web development features.

The website should include:

1. Modern UI/UX Design:
   - Stunning responsive design with mobile-first approach
   - Interactive elements with smooth animations
   - Modern color scheme and typography
   - Professional layout with hero sections
   - Interactive navigation and menus

2. User Management System:
   - Complete user registration with email verification
   - Secure login/logout functionality
   - Password reset with email confirmation
   - User profile management
   - Account settings and preferences
   - Session management with timeout
   - Remember me functionality

3. Database Operations:
   - MySQL database integration
   - User data storage with proper relationships
   - Product/service catalog management
   - Order processing system
   - Data validation and sanitization
   - Secure database connections

4. Security Features:
   - HTTPS/SSL encryption
   - CSRF protection
   - SQL injection prevention
   - XSS protection
   - Secure password hashing
   - Session security with regeneration
   - Input validation and sanitization
   - Security headers

5. Communication Features:
   - Contact form with email notifications
   - User-to-user messaging system
   - Email verification for registration
   - Password reset emails
   - Newsletter subscription

6. Core Functionality:
   - Product/service catalog with search and filtering
   - Shopping cart functionality
   - Order processing and tracking
   - Payment integration ready
   - Admin dashboard
   - Content management system
   - Analytics integration ready

7. Technical Requirements:
   - Use PHP for backend (plain PHP, no frameworks)
   - Use MySQL as the database
   - Use Apache2 as the web server
   - Responsive HTML/CSS/JavaScript frontend
   - Modern JavaScript with interactive features
   - AJAX for dynamic content loading
   - RESTful API endpoints
   - Proper cookie handling
   - Session-based authentication
   - Email integration

This should be a production-ready, enterprise-level website demonstrating all modern web development best practices.
